verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair front-door question for any public web service, so the axis applies. The only probe of a robots.txt, on the transactional host eddservices.edd.ca.gov, returned HTTP 403 rather than a readable file, so an agent cannot learn what it may fetch there. No evidence shows a real robots.txt on edd.ca.gov either, and the llms.txt and openapi probes are unrelated signals.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
